Plan JSON format:
{
 "actors": {"<name>": {"type": "new_user"}                      (registered and logged in automatically)
            | {"type": "existing", "email": "...", "password": "..."}   (only if the requirement gives credentials)
            | {"type": "anonymous"}},                            (no token)
 "steps": [{"id": "s1", "actor": "<actor name or omit>", "call": "<METHOD> <path exactly as listed>",
            "path": {"<param>": <value>}, "query": {...}, "body": {...},
            "role": "setup" | "action" | "verify"}],
 "checks": [{"id": "C1", "step": "<step id>", "expect": "<expectation>", "field": "<dotted path in the response>",
             "key": "<item key for list checks>", "value": <expected value>,
             "kind": "meaning" | "format", "description": "<short text>"}]
}
Expectations: status (exact code), status_class ("2xx"/"4xx"), field_equals, field_not_equals, field_exists,
field_absent, field_contains, field_not_contains, list_contains_item, list_not_contains_item, count_equals,
field_startswith.
Values can reference earlier results: "{{s1.id}}" (field of step s1's response), "{{s1.req.title}}"
(field of the request body sent in s1), "{{A.email}}", "{{A.id}}", "{{A.password}}" (actor data),
"{{rand.uuid}}", "{{rand.email}}", "{{rand.str}}" (random values).
Login and registration happen automatically for actors: do NOT add login or signup steps unless the
requirement is about logging in or signing up itself.
"setup" steps prepare data and must succeed; "action" is the call the requirement is about; "verify"
steps read state afterwards (for example to confirm something was saved or deleted).

Requirement: "Test the read me endpoint. Confirm the returned profile matches the registered email, is active, and is not a superuser."

API operations you may call:
GET /api/v1/users/me
Summary: Read User Me
Description: Get current user.
Tags: users
Auth required: yes
Response 200: Successful Response {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}

POST /api/v1/login/test-token

Description: Test access token
Tags: login
Auth required: yes
Response 200: Successful Response {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}

GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}

Description: Get a specific user by id.
Tags: users
Auth required: yes
Parameter (path, required): user_id string(uuid)
Response 200: Successful Response {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}
Response 422: Validation Error {detail: [{loc*: [string | integer], msg*: string, type*: string}]}

GET /api/v1/users/
Summary: Read Users
Description: Retrieve users.
Tags: users
Auth required: yes
Parameter (query, optional): skip integer
Parameter (query, optional): limit integer
Response 200: Successful Response {data*: [{email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}], count*: integer}

Description: Update a user.
Tags: users
Auth required: yes

Request body (application/json): {email: string(email) | null, is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, password: string | null}
Response 200: Successful Response {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}
Response 422: Validation Error {detail: [{loc*: [string | integer], msg*: string, type*: string}]}

POST /api/v1/users/
Summary: Create User
Description: Create new user.
Tags: users
Auth required: yes
Request body (application/json): {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, password*: string}
Response 200: Successful Response {email*: string(email), is_active: boolean, is_superuser: boolean, full_name: string | null, id*: string(uuid)}

{
 "actors": {
  "A": {
   "type": "new_user"
  }

  {
   "id": "s1",

  }

  {
   "id": "C1",
   "step": "s2",
   "expect": "status_class",
   "value": "2xx",
   "kind": "meaning",

  },
  {
   "id": "C2",
   "step": "s2",
   "expect": "field_equals",
   "field": "email",
   "value": "{{s1.req.email}}",
   "kind": "meaning",

  },
  {

   "expect": "field_equals",
   "field": "is_active",
   "value": true,

  },
  {

   "step": "s2",
   "expect": "field_equals",
   "field": "is_superuser",
   "value": false,
   "kind": "meaning",
   "description": "response is_superuser is false"
  }
 ]
}
